page.overview:
Who is Fairouz Ai?

Fairouz Ai Kadota (Japanese: 門田ファイルーズあい, Hepburn: Kadota Fairūzu Ai; born 6 July 1993), known simply as Fairouz Ai, is a Japanese voice actress who is affiliated with Mausu Promotion.

She played her first major role as Hibiki Sakura for the anime series How Heavy Are the Dumbbells You Lift?. She also played Alice Kagayaki in Kiratto Pri☆Chan, Manatsu Natsuumi/Cure Summer in Tropical-Rouge!

Precure, Emily Orange in Kandagawa Jet Girls, Eripiyo in If My Favorite Pop Idol Made It to the Budokan, I Would Die, Jolyne Cujoh in JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean, Takechiyo in Yashahime, Delta in The Eminence in Shadow, and Power in Chainsaw Man.
